verdict.rationale: The marketplace search page and public REST/CLI endpoints let anyone see live per-GPU-hour prices without an account or contacting sales (vast-ai-docs-41, vast-ai-probe-rt-2, vast-ai-probe-rt-3), which covers the core of the story. However, there's no dedicated static 'pricing page' listing every GPU type's rate at a glance—pricing is discovered via a dynamic search/filter interface, and a community user explicitly complained about the number of clicks needed to find even an approximate price (vast-ai-comm-3). Missing for 10: a single canonical pricing table/page enumerating all GPU types' rates, and stronger independent corroboration that pricing is easy to find without friction.
